idleSub: Pinda mutayera yega yega kuti uone kuti chii. Zvinotora masekonzi anenge 20.
pausedSub: Dzvanya kana kuti dzvanya Enter kuti uenderere mberi.
emptySub: Wedzera zvimwe zvinyorwa pamutambo uyu kuti utambike.
copyFail: Zvinyorwa zvasarudzwa. Zvikope neCtrl kana Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Mutambo wemepu yepfungwa. Famba nemunhu uyu uchienda kupfungwa imwe neimwe.
stageHow: Famba nemakiyi emacheche kana W A S D. Dzvanya N kuti uende kupfungwa inotevera. Dzvanya Escape kuti umise. Dzvanya Tab kuti uenderere mberi. Zvinyorwa zvese zviri zvakare pasi pe Verenga usingatambi.
hintKeys: Macheche kana WASD kufamba. N kupfungwa inotevera.
guideText: Pinda mutayera inopenya kuti uone kuti chii. Tayera rimwe nerimwe rauchabata rinobatana nemepu.
